productDirection.reason: One persisted personal request now drives the existing governed knowledge, retrieval, course AST, visual provenance, validation, publication, and runtime-manifest layers without exposing those internal steps to the user.

decisions: Use a bounded persisted state machine with compare-and-swap transitions and deterministic per-phase evidence.
Resume from exact committed knowledge, index, outline, course, deck, visual-placement, and publication identities instead of recreating them.
Enforce ceilings of 50 sources, 500 index work items, and 16 state transitions before any UI transport is added.
Prefer verified source-document visuals, then deterministic dataset charts, then fresh licensed network assets; never synthesize a placeholder graphic.
Allow text-only sources to complete without a visual review, but compress declared-yet-unverifiable visuals into one attention bundle.
Reuse the existing composer, slide builder, source visual, and network visual services unchanged because their evidence contracts already satisfied the orchestration boundary.
residualRisk: The orchestrator is still Helper-internal; Task 6 must expose authenticated typed create, status, and resolution jobs and manage supervisor startup and shutdown.
nextAction: Task 6: expose governed personal course jobs and a minimal typed Web client.
